objective: Test whether frozen R41S1F raw NOISE feature extractor and lane-specific logistic models can score candidates excluded by the original Minimal baseline. No retraining; no parameter changes, threshold selection or production adoption.
method: Replay exact frozen Minimal on group 1 fit and group 7 historical audit using identical raw SHA and R42A common registered arrays. For every row select original frozen path and lane, read four raw ON/OFF power contexts at physical frequency with r41s_5d_spiral.provenance; overlay input injection in original ON/OFF role only (as R41S1F); run unmodified R41S1F raw_diagnose; apply archived lane-specific imputation, scale, logistic coefficients, intercept and positive fit cutoff. No labels/truth in score computation. Exactly compare features for original supported archived alerts, and archived prediction scores/masks for original supported historical audit alerts. Archive null reason and score coverage for rejected candidates; fail closed on any original supported-score mismatch.
additional_output: Newly accessible previously rejected rows, feature support coverage and score-margins. No automatic inference when provenance or model unsupported; NaN with explicit reason. Do not infer full pipeline scalar or a valid global ROC from partial coverage; pilot qualifies only extraction and model parity.
gates: Authentic raw source and archive checksums, original R42A registered input equal
Frozen Minimal decisions and paths exact; original supported raw NOISE scores match archived for audit
No model tuning, no label leak into feature derivation
Coverage for originally rejected candidates explicitly measured, including null reasons
Full R42B still HOLD: original Parkes actual per-scan pointing and independent custodian
